INSERT OR IGNORE INTO report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow(reservation_id,day_utc,reserve_rows_read,reserve_rows_written,state,started_ts)
SELECT ?1,?2,5000,80,'RESERVED',?3 FROM (
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserve_rows_read),0) AS r,COALESCE(SUM(reserve_rows_written),0) AS w,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state='FINALIZED' AND COALESCE(unknown_ops,1)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS u,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reservation_id LIKE 'CODEX_SOURCE_STORAGE_FACTS:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS n
FROM report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow WHERE day_utc=?2)
WHERE r+5000<=3500000 AND w+80<=70000 AND u=0 AND n<2
